issue_context.title: Function information in error message should take along with database name
issue_context.body:
## Bug Report

Please answer these questions before submitting your issue. Thanks!

1. What did you do?
If possible, provide a recipe for reproducing the error.

```mysql
SELECT xxx( NULL );
```

2. What did you expect to see?

Function information should be `<database>.<function>` format.
```
ERROR 1305 (42000): FUNCTION randgen_test.xxx does not exist
```

3. What did you see instead?

```
ERROR 1305 (42000): FUNCTION xxx does not exist
```

4. What version of TiDB are you using (`tidb-server -V` or run `select tidb_version();` on TiDB)?
